description: Versioned scenario parameters for the Dallas Stars 2026-27 forecast.
Rates are validated to be positive; impossible games-played assumptions are rejected.

s2_defense.label: Goals-allowed changes with offense fixed (negative = improved defense)

s3_personnel.label: Forward departure with replacement (roster math, prior-season rates)
s3_personnel.note: Outgoing player's per-team-game goals replaced by a replacement at a role factor; never subtracts the full departure without replacement.

s3_personnel.label: Goaltending change with explicit goals-allowed assumption
s3_personnel.note: Goalie/defensive scenario requires an explicit GA assumption supported by goalie statistics; offensive points are never treated as defensive value.

s4_combined.label: Combined offense + defense + roster case (conditional, not a proven best prediction)
s4_combined.note: Show each component and order of application; label conditional on assumptions.
